acts.label: Prologue
acts.desc: A class of second graders is handed a sealed box with a mystery object inside. They are supposed to guess what it is, but the lesson goes off the rails.

acts.desc: A man is hired along with a crew to dig a mysterious hole on the slopes of Mt. Shasta. The hole goes sixty feet down. But what are they looking for?

A sparkly mystery. One woman hopes the military-industrial complex is involved.
Glitter X won’t tell which industry buys the most glitter. The podcast Endless Thread got to the bottom of it back in 2019.

acts.label: Act 2
acts.title: All That Glitters
